56:17.text: Immortal boys will go around them

56:18.text: With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine,

56:19.text: Wherefrom they will get neither any aching of the head, nor any intoxication.

56:20.text: And with fruit that they may choose.

56:21.text: And with the flesh of fowls that they desire.

56:22.text: (as wives for "Al-Muttaqûn" - the pious - See V. 2:2)

56:24.text: A reward for what they used to do.

56:25.text: will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech

56:26.text: But only the saying of: Salâm! Salâm!

56:27.text: And those on the Right Hand - how
will be those on the Right Hand?

56:29.text: with fruits piled one above another,

56:33.text: Whose supply is not cut off
, nor are they out of reach,

56:34.text: And on couches or thrones, raised high.

56:38.text: For those on the Right Hand.

56:39.text: will be from the first generation

56:40.text: will be from the later generations.

56:41.text: And those on the Left Hand - how
will be those on the Left Hand?

56:42.text: In fierce hot wind and boiling water,

56:45.text: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,

56:46.text: And were persisting in great sin
(joining partners in worship along with Allâh, committing murder and other crimes)

56:47.text: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected?

56:49.text: verily, those of old, and those of later times.

56:50.text: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed Meeting of a known Day.
